title: Crowd Cheering
blurb: Stadium-grade validation, available on demand and unearned by default. That is the appeal: this works for genuine victories, certainly, but it is far better applied to the smallest possible accomplishments — getting out of bed, finally replying to the email that has been open since Tuesday, parallel parking on the first attempt with somebody watching. Everybody deserves an arena moment occasionally, and standing ovations have historically been distributed on an unfair basis. This button corrects that. Thousands of strangers, delighted for you, about something extremely minor.
origin: Stadium crowd cheering — the universal victory ambience.
